title: Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences – Angels
fullTitle: Soul Feast #75: Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences – Angels

promo.text: Discover a new way of seeing and experiencing the world. Start your journey to multisensory perception HERE

description: In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav reveals something more fundamental than non-physical teachers: non-physical communication never stops. From a physics meeting at Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory to a first night at Esalen that could not have been random,
Gary traces the invisible guidance that shaped his awakening long before the personality had words for it.

As a young man hungry for meaning in the Earth School, he met the physicist who became his mentor and watched the chapters of The Dancing Wu Li Masters write and arrange themselves without outlines – until he could no longer pretend he was creating alone.

The through line is unmistakable: non-physical communication speaks through passion, through sudden knowing, through the chapters of a life that arrange themselves —and through the laughter of a grandmother who lingered at her own funeral to delight in her own transition.

Think of a moment that arrived too perfectly to be coincidence – a meeting, a passion, a knowing deeper than thought. What if that wasn’t luck? Where has non-physical communication already been at work in your story – and what might it be saying to you right now?
